image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light suspended against a clear blue sky. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black and contains three circular lenses: red (top, illuminated), amber/yellow (middle, unlit but visible), and green (bottom, illuminated). Each lens has a textured, faceted surface typical of LED or prismatic lenses and is shielded by a protruding visor. The unit is attached to a horizontal mast arm via a mounting bracket, with utility wires visible in the background.
